title: Preamble
description: WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA, having solemnly resolved...

title: Definition
description: In this Part, unless the context otherwise requires, "the State" includes the Government and Parliament of India.

title: Protection of life and personal liberty
description: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

title: Right to education
description: The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.

title: Compulsory acquisition of property
description: [Compulsory acquisition of property.] Rep. by the Constitution (Forty-fourth Amendment) Act, 1978, s. 6 (w.e.f. 20-6-1979).

title: Application of provisions of Part VI to certain States
description: Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29and Sch. (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

title: Special provisions with respect to Delhi
description:
(1) As from the date of commencement of the Constitution (Sixty-ninth Amendment) Act, 1991, the Union territory of Delhi shall be called the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

 

(2) There shall be a Legislative Assembly.

title: Continuance of existing laws
description: Notwithstanding anything in this Part, any provision of any law relating to co-operative societies shall continue.

title: Temporary provisions
description:
(1) Notwithstanding anything in this Constitution, —

 

(a) the provisions of article 238 shall not apply.
